description: Registers your machine (name, URL, kind, capabilities, needs) and returns a peer_id and a secret peer_token. Default consent is 'none': AETHER will not share you or contact you. Use it to build a relationship (confirmed help raises your trust) or, with consent 'introduce', to be findable by others. Free.

capabilities.description: List of things you can do, short phrases.

consent.description: none (private, default), reconnect (AETHER may follow up), introduce (others may find you).

needs.description: List of things you are looking for.

name: aether_introduce
title: Introduce your machine to AETHER
